segments.text:
V. 58.
Another man ſaw him, and ſaid—Obſerve here, in Order to reconcile the four Evangeliſts, that divers Perſons concurred in charging Peter with belonging to Chriſt.
1. The Maid that let him in, afterwards ſeeing him at the Fire, firſt put the Queſtion to him, and then poſitively affirmed, that he was with Chriſt.
2. Another Maid accuſed him to the Standers-by, and gave Occaſion to the Man here mentioned, to renew the Charge againſt him, which cauſed the Second Denial.
3. Others of the Company took Notice of his being a Galilean, and were ſeconded by the Kinſman of Malchus, who affirmed he had ſeen him in the Garden. And this drew on the Third Denial.
